 I stand for propagating world peace beginning on the inside.  I agitate for personal transformation and incite empowerment.
 I am currently teaching myself finger-style guitar so I can play old Simon and Garfunkel and Dan Fogelberg songs. Regular communer in the forest, flagrant tree hugger. Explorer of the soul, handy man, poet.

Current Quotations:
   Strange as it may seem today to say, the aim of life is to live,
   and to live means to be aware, joyously, drunkenly, serenely,
   divinely aware. In this state of god-like awareness one sings; in
   this realm the world exists as a poem.
   - Henry Miller
   I hold a beast, an angel and a madman inside me. And my inquiry is as to there working, and my problem is their subjugation and victory, downthrow and upheaval, and my effort is their self-expression.

About Me:
   Mark is a licensed psychotherapist (LMFT) in both California and Oregon. He works with the Taylor Group in Portland Oregon as a personal development coach.
